Gaussian noise 20 dB SNR.scope: signal power computed independently for each complete window over all time samples and all selected channels
Gaussian noise 20 dB SNR.formula: P_signal=mean(X^2); P_noise=P_signal/10^(SNR_dB/10); iid N(0,1) scaled by sqrt(P_noise)

Dropout 5%.scope: independent element-wise Bernoulli mask over time × channel entries
Dropout 5%.missing_representation: standardized value set to 0 by multiplication with mask
Dropout 5%.interpretation: synthetic missing-value sensitivity, not a physical packet-loss model

Temporal jitter.scope: each window is circularly shifted as a whole along the time axis
Temporal jitter.note: all channels in a window receive the same shift; np.roll implies wrap-around
Temporal jitter.interpretation: synthetic timing sensitivity; not timestamp jitter in milliseconds

Selected-channel offset sweep.interpretation: standardized sensitivity coordinate, not degrees Celsius

Burst corruption.interpretation: synthetic transient corruption; not measured EMI
